h: Analysis says North-West and South-West could decide the 2027 presidential race
p: An analysis based on the 2026 voter register argues that the North-West and South-West hold the most voters and could swing the 2027 presidential election. The parties are expected to focus their campaigns on both zones. The figures come from the electoral commission's register.
more: Both zones carry the largest voter numbers on the register.
Campaign teams across the parties are likely to target them.
